AGHAST.gloss: struck with fear, dread, or consternation
AGHAST.definition: Struck with fear, dread, or consternation.

SAGA.gloss: a narrative telling the adventures of a hero or a family
SAGA.definition: A narrative telling the adventures of a hero or a family; originally (12th to 14th centuries) a story of the families that settled Iceland and their descendants but now any prose narrative that resembles such an account.

STAG.gloss: a male deer, especially an adult male red deer
STAG.definition: A male deer, especially an adult male red deer.

SHAG.gloss: a strong coarse tobacco that has been shredded
SHAG.definition: A strong coarse tobacco that has been shredded.

GAS.gloss: the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by
GAS.definition: The state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by: relatively low density and viscosity; relatively great expansion and contraction with changes in pressure and temperature; the ability to diffuse readily; and the spontaneous tendency to become distributed uniformly throughout any container.

HAT.gloss: headdress that protects the head from bad weather
HAT.definition: Headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim.

TAG.gloss: attach a tag or label to
TAG.definition: Attach a tag or label to.

ASH.gloss: the residue that remains when something is burned
ASH.definition: The residue that remains when something is burned.
